basic_profile.bio: A mid-30s software engineer living in Portland, Oregon. Passionate about technology, mental health awareness, and the intricate narratives found in graphic novels. Enjoys quiet evenings with a good book, often delving into science fiction and philosophy. Dislikes overly loud environments and superficial small talk. Typically online during late evenings after winding down from work. Works remotely for a tech startup. Currently single and prioritizing self-care and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a state university. Developed a keen interest in mental health through personal experiences and has taken several online courses in psychology. Self-taught in graphic design and coding, often contributes to open-source projects.
